title: Service Recovery Scale: Meal Vouchers, Hotel Nights and Goodwill by Crestline Fare Brand
content:
**Customer Care service recovery scale for Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** The scale applies to disruptions whose recorded cause is controllable. Amounts are in US dollars per passenger.

## Care

| Fare brand | Meal voucher from arrival delay of (hours) | Meal voucher face value | Hotel night for a controllable cancellation or misconnection forcing an overnight stay |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Basic Economy | 3 | 15 | Provided |
| Crestline Main Cabin | 3 | 15 | Provided |
| Crestline Main Plus | 3 | 15 | Provided |
| Crestline Main Flexible | 3 | 15 | Provided |
| Crestline Premium Economy | 3 | 25 | Provided |
| Crestline First | 3 | 25 | Provided |

## Goodwill

| Fare brand | Delay band 1 reached at (hours) | Delay band 2 reached at (hours) | Delay goodwill, band 1 | Delay goodwill, band 2 | Cancellation or missed-connection goodwill | Summit miles per goodwill dollar | Goodwill payments allowed in the rolling 12-month window |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Basic Economy | 3 | 6 | 50 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 2 |
| Crestline Main Cabin | 3 | 6 | 75 | 150 | 150 | 100 | 2 |
| Crestline Main Plus | 3 | 6 | 75 | 150 | 150 | 100 | 2 |
| Crestline Main Flexible | 3 | 6 | 75 | 150 | 150 | 100 | 2 |
| Crestline Premium Economy | 3 | 6 | 150 | 250 | 250 | 100 | 3 |
| Crestline First | 3 | 6 | 200 | 350 | 350 | 100 | 3 |

## Notes

- "Reached at" is inclusive: an arrival delay of exactly 3 hours reaches band 1 and the meal-voucher point; exactly 6 hours reaches band 2.
- The goodwill value may be taken as Summit miles at 100 miles per dollar on every brand; a 150-dollar goodwill value therefore corresponds to 15,000 miles (hypothetical illustration).
- The 12-month window is the rolling 365 calendar days ending on, and including, the flight date of the disruption being compensated.
